thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout starting now — components: api@v2.14.0, runtime@v3.9.1, router@v1.5.4, console@v0.24.0. Canary 3% eu-west1 -> holding 15m before ramp. Release window: 23:00-03:00 UTC.

maria: quick note — runtime has the kv-evict change. we should pin runtime for router compatibility during canary. saw a mismatch last week.

ethan: confirmed. runtime v3.9.1 includes kv-evict behavior change behind feature flag `kv_eviction_v2`. we turned it on in ci but not prod. plan: enable flag after router has pinned route header `x-kv-mode`.

jordan: router needs a header to opt into the new eviction behavior. currently router default strips that header for old api routes. we can add a passthrough but need console to show toggle otherwise support will be flooded.

kailey: console @ me — UI toggle landing PR depends on console@0.24.0 assets. if console deploys before the API+runtime handshake, the toggle will be present but non-functional (backend not ready). recommend delaying console until after router+runtime canary passes.

sahil: +1 to holding console. ops request: can we do staged daisy-chain: api + runtime canary -> verify 30m -> router small config roll -> verify 30m -> console last? keeps rollback surface small.

ethan: that sequence works. also adding fallback: runtime will expose `X-KV-Mode: legacy` if healthcheck sees router missing header. so runtime can auto-fallback during mismatch. config is in `runtime/config/kv_mode_auto_fallback=true`.

maria: please pin runtime image on Dedicated clusters to `sha256:8f5b...` so we don't accidentally pick newer builds mid-window. I'll create a pin request.

deploy-bot: Canary update: api@v2.14.0 at 3% successful (200/206 responses showing new schema). No errors in runtime logs yet.

jordan: logs look clean on router side. added rule to preserve `x-kv-mode` for canary routes: `route-annotation: preserve-headers: [x-kv-mode]`. Rolling that to 5% now.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window SLA = 99.9% for latency. If we exceed 2x p95 for 10m, abort and rollback.

sahil: monitoring hooks added: p95-api, runtime-kernel-errors, router-header-drop-rate. Alert groups ping #oncall and #eng-releases.

maria: pin request filed: Ticket INF-4582, pin runtime image to sha256:8f5b... for eu-west deployments until 2026-04-05.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% now. Small uptick in kernel warnings (runtime) +1.6% — triaging.

ethan: seeing the kernel warnings in one worker pool (gpu-pool-3). rolling that pool back to previous kernel build via k-patch. initiating rollback on gpu-pool-3 only, not full runtime.

maria: thanks — confirm: router still at 5%? don't want router at higher percentage while runtime is partially rolled back.

jordan: holding router at 5%. no further ramp.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback applied to gpu-pool-3. Canary stabilized, kernel warnings back to baseline.

sahil: good. increase canary to 25% but keep console blocked. we want more traffic on api+runtime to validate the eviction flag flows.

deploy-bot: Canary 25% complete. Runtime metrics and api p95 within thresholds. Router header drop rate = 0.2%.

kailey: I'll queue console for final step but will hold the asset rollout until we see sustained 25% for 45m. no UI release before that.

ethan: when we flip `kv_eviction_v2` on, we need to coordinate a short metric check: if `kv-miss-rate` increases > 0.8% for 5m, auto-set flag off. that's in the autosafety harness.

deploy-bot: Autosafety configured: `kv_miss_rate_threshold=0.8%`, `evaluation_window=5m`, `action=flag-off`.

maria: release notes snippet for customer-facing changelog: "Improved KV eviction logic to reduce memory pressure; opt-in via header `x-kv-mode=new` until fully rolled out." I'll drop it in the release notes doc after final confirmation.

ops-bot: Heads-up: if we abort, rollback order = console -> router -> api -> runtime (reverse of daisy chain) to minimize client-visible regressions.

sahil: agreed. also: set abort flag if error budget burn > 10% within window.

deploy-bot: Canary steady for 45m at 25%. ready for router ramp to 60% and then console.

jordan: ramping router to 60% now. will watch header-preserve metrics.

deploy-bot: Router at 60%. small spike in stereo logs from old clients — ignoring, not related to header.

kailey: console assets ready. will deploy console@0.24.0 to canary group once router at 60% for 20m. final smoke tests in `console/e2e/kv_toggle_spec`.

ethan: flipping `kv_eviction_v2=true` in runtime for canary traffic now.

deploy-bot: Flag flip done. Autosafety monitoring armed.

sahil: monitor: kv-miss-rate stable. no action from autosafety.

deploy-bot: Router at 60% for 25m, all metrics within thresholds. Proceeding with console canary at 5%.

kailey: console canary looks good, toggle visible and backend responds with `x-kv-mode=new` when enabled. smoke test passed.

maria: updating release notes: added paragraph about rollout, pinned runtime sha, and rollback plan.

deploy-bot: Full rollout scheduled to complete in 40m. final checkpoint: any objections?

ethan: no objections. tracking patch notes for runtime-changelog.

jordan: no objections. router config will be committed to infra repo `infra/router-preserve-headers` with canary annotations.

sahil: no objections. oncall standing by 1h post-rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed. All components at target versions. No aborts.

maria: thumbs up :thumbsup: Good job team. I'll merge release notes and send customer-facing blurb tomorrow morning.

kailey: will follow up with post-deploy UI telemetry in #product-analytics.

ops-bot: Post-deploy checklist: close INF-4582, update pin expiry, document kernel rollback in incident log if needed.

maria: closing INF-4582 now. pin expiry set to 2026-04-05.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot.
